senses.gloss: f. (preced.) [that which is brought in; cmp. תְּבוּאָה,] harvest, provision; income.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 40:20">Targ. Job XL, 20</cite> (h. text <cite ref="B00612"><he>בול</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 30:23">Targ. Is. XXX, 23</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 25:21">Targ. Lev. XXV, 21</cite>; a. fr.—

Ned. 55ᵃ פקיד … מן ע׳ דנהר פניא left in his will that they should give Raba thirteen thousand Zuz out of the ʿălalta (income) of N’har Pania; היכי מיקריא ע׳ what is understood by ʿălalta? Ib. תבואה … ע׳ כל מילי משמע by t’buah (= תבואת שדה) we understand only the five kinds of grain, by ʿălalta, anything (income).

Ib. שכר בתים … כיון דפחתן לאו ע׳ היא וכ׳ how about the rent from houses or ships? Shall we say, because their value is diminishing by wear and tear, it cannot be called ʿălalta (income), or is it to be called ʿălalta, because the diminution is not noticeable?; a. e.—Pl. עֲלָלָן, עֲלָלָתָא.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 14:22">Targ. Y. II, Deut. XIV, 22</cite>.
Targ. O. Gen. XLVII, 24 עָלְלָתָא ed. Lsb. (ed. Berl. עָלַלְתָּא; oth. ed. עֲלַלְתָּא, sing.); a. e.
